result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers are polished dark two-pane queues with eight bike-rental tickets and a shortcut legend in the footer. A also gives each row a text priority label instead of relying on color alone, cuts long subjects off cleanly with an ellipsis, and puts a visible Undo button with its shortcut key in the action bar. B marks priority in the list only with a colored bar, and it offers undo only through its footer shortcut. The behavior items (2–4 and 6) can't be checked from a static screenshot, so those scores are inferred. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers use the same split layout and show their keyboard shortcuts, including undo with Z, in a footer. A shows priority with colored bars only and gives no evidence of how it handles long subjects. Neither screenshot can show motion, reduced-motion handling, the empty state or narrow-width behavior, so I scored those items conservatively.
